title: Bibu's low fire
description: Lower flames so they're never hindered in combat again.
body:
**📉 Bibu's Low Fire**

A minimalist resource pack designed to reduce the height of flames in-game, increasing your visibility during combat or in survival mode. Perfect for PvP and lightweight setups.

**✨ Features:**

* Reduced flame height for a clear view.

* Smooth animation preserved.

* Compatible with all Minecraft versions from 1.21 onwards.
